roles.forest: Primary brand foundation; approved logos and dark surfaces.
roles.ivory: Primary light surface and text on forest, wine or rosewood.
roles.wine: Main accent, used sparsely for selection and editorial details on light surfaces.
roles.rosewood: Less frequent secondary accent for secondary surfaces and hover details.

rules: Keep approved forest/ivory and monochrome logo exports unchanged; this palette does not authorize wine or rosewood logos.
Forest and wine have poor mutual contrast. Separate them with ivory; do not use wine text on forest.
Use ivory foreground on wine or rosewood surfaces; verify actual interface contrast for each state.
Decorative wine must remain distinct from semantic error states through role, labeling and iconography; color alone never communicates errors.
Restaurant tenant colors remain tenant-owned; this is the platform brand palette.
